mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFastPois: Replaces iterative loops in radiation calculations with O(1) sampling.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableAdaptive: Adaptive tick backoff when ejectors or pipes encounter blocked targets.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableSolarLig: Caches skylight checks and skips nighttime solar raycasting instantly.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableOwnerChu: Puts anchor upgrades and dimensional stabilizers to sleep when the owner is offline.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFactoryA: Zero-allocation auto-sort item balancing for Mekanism and Addon (AME/Extras) factories.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableMultiblo: Adaptive tick caching for multiblocks during steady states.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableAddonOpt: Enables performance optimizations for Astral Mekanism and Mekanism Extras.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableRadiatio: O(1) instant bypass for entity radiation calculations when world has no active radiation.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableCableBac: Adaptive backoff for cables when targets are fully charged.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableLookingA: Caches unit display formatting for Jade and HUD tooltips.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableWindGene: O(1) height multiplier caching and adaptive skylight checks for Wind Generators.
Frustum culling for Wind Generators to skip rendering off-screen models.
Pre-baked static mast/body and rigid rotor meshes to reduce matrix transforms.
Zero-allocation direct rendering to eliminate per-frame capturing lambda allocations.
3-tier distance-adaptive Level of Detail and far-distance culling.
Rotation angle quantization and throttling for distant wind generators.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableFluidTan: Fluid tank rendering cache and lookup optimizations.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableEnergyCu: Energy cube rendering object pool optimizations.
mekanism_optimizer.config.enableDedicate: Writes dedicated optimization statistics and performance metrics to logs/mekanism_optimizer.log.
mekanism_optimizer.config.solarLightCach: Time-to-live in ticks for cached skylight visibility.
mekanism_optimizer.config.logIntervalSec: Interval in seconds for performance statistics logging (0 to disable).
mekanism_optimizer.config.windGeneratorS: Wind Generator Sky Check Interval Ticks
Interval in ticks between skylight occlusion checks for Wind Generators.
mekanism_optimizer.config.energyCubePool: Maximum pooled LazyRender instances for energy cube rendering.
mekanism_optimizer.config.windGeneratorL: Distance threshold in blocks for mid-distance LOD model rendering.
Distance threshold in blocks for far-distance LOD model rendering.
mekanism_optimizer.config.windGeneratorC: Distance threshold in blocks beyond which wind generator rendering is completely skipped.
mekanism_optimizer.config.windGeneratorM: Rotor rotation quantization angle in degrees for mid-distance wind generators.
mekanism_optimizer.config.windGeneratorF: Rotor rotation quantization angle in degrees for far-distance wind generators.
